title: District-wise Rural Household Tap Water Coverage
description: Baseline rural household tap water supply coverage percentage under Jal Jeevan Mission across Indian districts.
source_name: Open Government Data Platform India / Ministry of Jal Shakti
publisher: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
notes: Official JJM baseline reporting tap water connection percentage at district level.

title: District-wise Functional Primary Health Infrastructure Availability
description: Functional Primary Health Centres (PHC) and sub-centres infrastructure readiness and facility availability across Indian districts under Rural Health Statistics.
source_name: Open Government Data Platform India / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
notes: Official MoHFW Rural Health Statistics (RHS) baseline tracking functional rural primary health infrastructure.

title: District-wise ODF Plus Verified Village Sanitation Coverage
description: District-level percentage of villages verified as Open Defecation Free (ODF) Plus with functional solid and liquid waste management under Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) Phase II.
source_name: Open Government Data Platform India / Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)
publisher: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
notes: Official SBM-G Phase II baseline for ODF Plus verified village coverage and rural sanitation.

title: District-wise Rural Habitation Road Connectivity Coverage under PMGSY
description: Percentage of eligible rural habitations connected by all-weather roads under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) across Indian districts.
source_name: Open Government Data Platform India / Ministry of Rural Development
publisher: National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency (NRIDA), Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
notes: Official PMGSY OMMAS baseline for all-weather rural road connectivity.
